---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish that the current version makes hard
or impossible?

## Proposed solution

What would the API or behavior look like? Code sketch is welcome.

## Alternatives considered

If you've already explored workarounds, mention them and why they
weren't sufficient.

## Scope

- [ ] voigtfit (fitting solvers, encoders, benchmarks)
- [ ] toyomacro foundation (lineshapes, data, IO)
- [ ] GUI / Web client
- [ ] Documentation
